Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers need to know that companion animal bookings need a careful check before travel, and we are sorry if the extra steps feel slow. Aurelia Skyways wants each pet to travel safely and with as little stress as possible.

Please read the pet details closely and make sure the carrier fits the rules for the animal, the crate, and the cabin space. <<FACT F061>> Travelers who arrive with a mismatch may need a recheck at the desk, and that can delay boarding. <<FACT F067>> Our review also looks at temperament, comfort, and the route so that the care plan suits the pet, not just the paper trail.

If you are unsure about any part of the setup, bring your documents and ask for help before you head to security. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will go through the details with you and help avoid last-minute surprises.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for guidance before you fly.
